questions.title: Does the manual state these troubleshooting facts?

source.text: NOTE: If you experience air motor icing, contact your Graco distributor for assistance.

proposal: 1. Symptom 'Air motor icing' -> MAY_INDICATE -> FailureMode 'Unspecified cause of air motor icing'. Meaning: The symptom may indicate the specified failure mode.

options.label: Yes, all correct
options.effect: all statements enter the graph as verified

options.label: No, none is stated
options.effect: the statements stay out of the graph

options.label: Only some are correct
options.effect: only the statement numbers you list enter the graph

answers.text: The manual advises contacting a Graco distributor for assistance if air motor icing occurs; it does not state a cause.
answers.rationale: The note gives an action to take for air motor icing but does not say the symptom may indicate an unspecified failure mode.
